argv: query=mutation EnqueuePullRequest($pullRequestId: ID!, $expectedHeadOid: GitObjectID!) { enqueuePullRequest(input: { pullRequestId: $pullRequestId, expectedHeadOid: $expectedHeadOid }) { mergeQueueEntry { id } } }

instructions: Run the `merge queue` command shown above exactly as printed.

If the gh CLI says auto-merge is disabled instead of adding the PR to the queue, run the `queue API fallback` command: `gh api graphql -f 'query=mutation EnqueuePullRequest($pullRequestId: ID!, $expectedHeadOid: GitObjectID!) { enqueuePullRequest(input: { pullRequestId: $pullRequestId, expectedHeadOid: $expectedHeadOid }) { mergeQueueEntry { id } } }' -f pullRequestId=PR_kwDOAAAAAAA -f expectedHeadOid=abc123`.
Then iterate immediately with the same options to monitor until the PR merges or needs work.
